patch_description: The current snake-deal packing matches greedy quality (GPU 0.66 / expert 0.25) at zero algorithm time. To push balancedness higher, I add a fully vectorized local-search refinement pass after the snake packing: compute pack loads with a single `scatter_add`, then repeatedly find the heaviest-loaded and lightest-loaded pack per row, and swap the heaviest item of the overloaded pack with the lightest item of the underloaded pack whenever it provably shrinks the max-min load gap. Each refinement round is a handful of vectorized tensor ops over all layers simultaneously, with an early exit when no row improves, so the runtime overhead stays tiny while the packing quality strictly improves over plain greedy/snake (which never swaps). This refinement is applied in both packing steps (groups→nodes and physical experts→GPUs), so both GPU-level and expert-level balancedness improve while keeping the exact output format.
